Hello! I can help. 

Look at the bottom numbers. We have 3 and 6. 

How do we get from 3 to 6 using times?
Is it 2/6? I just copied the top number. This is too hard, I hate fractions.

That is okay. Fractions can be hard. 

Take a deep breath. You can do this. 

Look at the bottom numbers, 3 and 6. 

What is 3 times 2?
is it 4/6 because you times the top and bottom by 2 Next one: 2/9 + 4/9?

You got the first one right! Good job. 

Now look at the next sum: 2/9 plus 4/9. 

The bottom numbers are the same. They are both 9. 

What do you do with the top numbers, 2 and 4?
umm I add them to get 6 and I add the 9s too I guess so maybe it is 6/18

You did a great job adding the top numbers to get 6. 

When we add fractions with the same bottom number, the bottom number stays the same. 

So the bottom number is 9. 

Can you tell me the final fraction now?

No, not quite. 

Remember, the bottom number stays the same. 

It does not change. 

The bottom number is 9. 

What is the top number and the bottom number together?
Oh I get it now, it is 6/9 because you just add the top numbers and the bottom one stays the same. Next one: 1/4 + 1/8?

Yes! You got it. 

Now we have 1/4 plus 1/8. 

The bottom numbers are different. They are 4 and 8. 

Can you change 1/4 so the bottom number is 8?
